definitionZh: 卷轴时间线CSS的短手属性用于定义一个命名的卷轴进度时间表,通过在上下(或左右)之间滚动一个可滚动元素(滚动器)来推进.
sourceDefinition: The scroll-timeline CSS shorthand property is used to define a named scroll progress timeline, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller) between top and bottom (or left and right).
